0022600018.text: The Knicks (2-3, 8th in the East) visit the 76ers (4-1, 1st in the Atlantic) in the 6th game of New York's season and an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B matchup, with New York coming in on a two-game win streak and Philadelphia on a one-game streak. The Knicks are 1-1 on the road this season, while the 76ers are 2-1 at home, and the 2026-27 season series has New York trailing 0-1 after a 106-100 loss in New York on October 20. The 2025-26 season was split 2-2, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 playoffs 4-0. New York is missing Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain), while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain), and Jaylen Brown is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision.
